en.headline: Open House Hong Kong returns with guided tours of more than 80 buildings
en.dek: The third edition of the architecture festival runs across three weekends from 28 November to 13 December, opening distinctive spaces including Villa Haw Par and the International Gateway Centre.
body: Open House Hong Kong begins its third edition today, running from 28 November to 13 December across three consecutive weekends. The programme opens more than 80 buildings and urban spaces for guided tours, themed walks and talks.

Organised by a team of architects and designers and supported by Design Trust as Foundation Partner, the festival aims to let the public explore design stories behind Hong Kong's architecture and discuss what makes a city liveable, inclusive and resilient. Highlights this year include the recently completed International Gateway Centre above West Kowloon Station, the Grade I historic Villa Haw Par, and the revitalised Chun On Pawn Shop now operating as a community space.

Many sessions are led by architects, designers or venue staff. Some visits require advance booking through the organiser's platform, with a refundable deposit, while selected sites allow walk-ins. The event is part of the global Open House network and continues the annual effort started in 2024 to promote architectural appreciation in the city.
The programme includes neighbourhood routes and dialogue sessions alongside the building visits. Details of individual tours and registration are available from the organisers.

zh.headline: 第三屆打開香港今日展開 逾80座建築開放導賞
zh.dek: 建築節由11月28日至12月13日一連三個周末舉行，開放虎豹別墅、環球匯等特色空間供公眾導賞及參觀。
body: 第三屆「打開香港」今日展開，活動由11月28日至12月13日一連三個周末舉行，開放超過80座建築及城市空間，供公眾參加導賞、主題散步及對談。
活動由建築師及設計師團隊策劃，並獲信言設計大使作為基金會夥伴支持，旨在讓公眾了解香港建築背後的設計故事，並探討何謂宜居、共融和具韌性的城市。今年重點包括西九龍站上蓋新落成的環球匯、一級歷史建築虎豹別墅，以及活化後的振安大押現作社區空間。
不少導賞由建築師、設計師或場地人員帶領。部分場地須預先登記，並設可退還按金；部分則可即場參觀。活動屬全球Open House網絡，延續2024年開始的年度建築賞析計劃。
節目除建築參觀外，還包括社區路線及對談環節。個別導賞詳情及報名安排可由主辦單位查閱。
